mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the tendency of media workers to imbibe the ideas, attitude and opinions of the group they cover or with whom they interact over time."
Acculturation is the tendency of media workers to imbibe the ideas, attitude and opinions of the group they cover or with whom they interact over time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the touchstone for defensible decisions regarding development in and expansion of content and services in the PSM context."
A public service ethos is the touchstone for defensible decisions regarding development in and expansion of content and services in the PSM context.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the enactments made to regulate the activities and operation of the mass media."
Media laws are the enactments made to regulate the activities and operation of the mass media.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the channels through which mass communication messages pass to the audience."
The mass media are the channels through which mass communication messages pass to the audience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that local, short- term contingencies can exercise lasting effects."
Path-dependence means that local, short- term contingencies can exercise lasting effects.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act, under the dictate of the person, organisation or institution, that exerts the force on the media."
Control is the act, under the dictate of the person, organisation or institution, that exerts the force on the media.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very potent medium of Mass communication."
The television is a very potent medium of Mass communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the corporate body saddled with the responsibility of regulating broadcasting in Nigeria."
The National Broadcasting Commission (NBC) is the corporate body saddled with the responsibility of regulating broadcasting in Nigeria.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the standard of good or bad conduct in a given situation or profession using norms and morality as the bases for the valuation of human conduct or behaviour."
Ethics is the standard of good or bad conduct in a given situation or profession using norms and morality as the bases for the valuation of human conduct or behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a recent development in mass communication practice in Nigeria."
Broadcasting is a recent development in mass communication practice in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major source of income to any mass medium, hence the interest of advertisers is usually held in high esteem by media operators."
Advertisers' Control Advertisement is a major source of income to any mass medium, hence the interest of advertisers is usually held in high esteem by media operators.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the concern, significant and meaningful desire and information needs of members of the society, especially those who perceive the broadcast media content."
Public interest means the concern, significant and meaningful desire and information needs of members of the society, especially those who perceive the broadcast media content.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relationship that is grounded in utmost trust and confidence."
A fiduciary relationship is a relationship that is grounded in utmost trust and confidence.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all the various elements, mainly of collective application or relating to collective interests, in the society that regulate mass media operation or contents."
Socio-cultural control refers to all the various elements, mainly of collective application or relating to collective interests, in the society that regulate mass media operation or contents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of inter- personal communication that involves two people at a time."
Dyadic communication is a type of inter- personal communication that involves two people at a time.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the socio- economic interest of media owners and operators on one side, and the general interest and information needs of the public (media audience)."
The two interests are the socio- economic interest of media owners and operators on one side, and the general interest and information needs of the public (media audience).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the underlying reason, attitude and conventions that govern media content selection and the operation of the mass media generally and journalism practice in particular."
Media philosophy is the underlying reason, attitude and conventions that govern media content selection and the operation of the mass media generally and journalism practice in particular.
